t: Adds support for managing table pre-warming in Amazon Keyspaces (for Apache Cassandra)
This release provides change data capture (CDC) streams support through updates to the Amazon Keyspaces API.
Removing replication region limitation for Amazon Keyspaces Multi-Region Replication APIs.
Amazon Keyspaces: adding the list of IAM actions required by the UpdateKeyspace API.
Amazon Keyspaces Multi-Region Replication: Adds support to add new regions to multi and single-region keyspaces.
Adds support for interacting with user-defined types (UDTs) through the following new operations: Create-Type, Delete-Type, List-Types, Get-Type.
This release adds support for Multi-Region Replication with provisioned tables, and Keyspaces auto scaling APIs
This release adds support for MRR GA launch, and includes multiregion support in create-keyspace, get-keyspace, and list-keyspace.
Enabled FIPS endpoints for GovCloud (US) regions in SDK.
Fixing formatting issues in CLI and SDK documentation
Adding link to CloudTrail section in Amazon Keyspaces Developer Guide
This release adds support for data definition language (DDL) operations
